loveLetter.title: a letter for you 📜
loveLetter.text: From the day I met you until now, my life has changed in the most beautiful ways. You walked in and everything just made sense. Every laugh we’ve shared, every late-night conversation, and even every silly argument—I wouldn’t trade a single second of it. You are my favorite person, my best friend, and the reason I smile every single day. Happy 23rd birthday, my love. Here’s to a lifetime more of us. ❤️
